## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `GkeHubClient`: The GKE Hub service handles the registration of many Kubernetes clusters to Google Cloud, and the management of multi-cluster features over those clusters.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `GkeHubClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudGKEHubV1
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(projectId: String, locationId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudGKEHubV1.GkeHubClient()
  let items = client.listMembershipsByItems(
    request: ListMembershipsRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "projects/\(projectId)/locations/\(locationId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-gkehub-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-gkehub-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudGKEHubV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudGKEHubV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-gkehub-v1
```
